294130: A rare slime that is almost never seen. It has no official name and is variously referred to as the "Weakest Slime" or the "Fragile Slime.
294131: In a world where all people receive skills from God, she is a young girl who received a tamer skill. However, her rank is the weakest: "starless." As the starless are considered ominous, she was abandoned by her family and chased away from her village.
323649: The Adandara is a high-tier monster resembling a black panther. It is a species so ferocious that it is said encountering one in the forest spells certain death, and that defeating a single specimen requires the combined efforts of multiple teams of high-ranking adventurers.
323652: The fortune teller of Latomi Village. She possesses a "One-Star" precognitive ability. To the village, she is an invaluable figure who divines the optimal harvest season for their local specialty, Zaro.
323653: The captain of the Latme Village Vigilante Corps. He and his squad take turns performing duties such as manning the village gates and conducting patrols.
323654: A member of the Latome Village Vigilante Corps. As the Vice-Captain, he assists Captain Oguto. He is a long-suffering man who is constantly at the mercy of the impulsive Captain Oguto—always rushing around to rein the Captain in or clean up after his messes.
323655: The leader of the elite adventurer group "Sword of Flame." Despite his intimidating appearance, he possesses a gentle nature.
323656: A member of the elite adventurer group "Sword of Flame." Cheerful and good-natured, he looks after others well—particularly Ivy, whom he regards as a younger sister. He has a sweet tooth.
323659: The leader of the elite adventurer group "Thunder King." He is a top-tier figure among adventurers—distinguished enough to also serve as the leader of the Monster Extermination Squad.
323660: A member of the elite adventurer group "Thunder King." He has a fondness for cute things and has taken a particular liking to Sora. He is skilled at remembering faces. His skills include Hand-to-Hand Combat (Rank 2), Water Magic (Rank 2), and One-Handed Swords (Rank 2).
323663: A member of the adventurer group Verdant Wind. She is a beautiful and mature-looking woman, though she has a bit of a clumsy streak. A 2-star Tamer, she commands two rare slimes named Rustal and Riedel. She has a fondness for sweets and is kind to Ivy.
323665: A member of the adventurer group Verdant Wind. He is Meela's older brother and Malma's twin—sharing a resemblance in face, voice, and personality. He possesses a 2-star Defense skill and a 1-star Longsword skill. He has a fondness for sweets.
323666: A member of the adventurer group Verdant Wind. He is Meela's older brother and Tolto's twin—sharing a resemblance in face, voice, and personality. He possesses a 2-star skill in Two-Handed Swords and a 1-star skill in Water Attacks. He has a fondness for sweets.
